scripts._comment:gate:assets: Weighs what the *browser* downloads. `gate:bundle` weighs the Worker script, which is why the 3.26 MB login logo (audit P1) was invisible to CI: Cloudflare stores static assets separately, against no bundle limit. Needs a real ../frontend/dist, so CI runs it from the frontend job — see .github/workflows/ci.yml.
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply CareerLinkAI_Staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply CareerLinkAI_Main --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:staff && npm run db:seed:catalog:full && npm run db:seed:ai-policy
scripts._comment:db:seed:catalog: The 10-career demo fixture (seed 0002). NOT chained into `db:seed` — it and 0004 both seed 'Software Engineer', 'UP Diliman' etc. under different ids, and neither colleges.name nor careers.title is unique, so running both yields visible duplicate cards in a student's top ten. Kept **local-only**, for reproducing pre-audit behaviour: the `:staging` runner that used to sit beside it was deleted in P1-3, because reproducing the defect on a deployed database is not a use case and P2-2 had to archive duplicate careers off staging by hand. test/platform/seed-chain.test.ts enforces both halves of that.
scripts._comment:db:backup: Plan P3-5. Exports AND verifies: the dump's per-table row counts are compared against the live database's own COUNT(*), because `wrangler d1 export` exits 0 on an empty database and a mistargeted --env writes a perfect backup of nothing, every night, until the restore. Retention and the offsite copy are in BACKUP-AND-RECOVERY.md.
scripts._comment:db:restore: Takes --from/--into and refuses to guess either. For an in-place rollback inside 30 days use `wrangler d1 time-travel restore` instead — it needs no dump and leaves no window in which the data is absent.
scripts._comment:db:restore:drill: The rehearsal. Restores a backup into a throwaway local database, boots the real Worker against it, and asserts a student is served the recommendations the backup holds. Nothing it does can reach a deployed database.
